interfaces.name: TF / microSD
interfaces.notes: 真实SPI卡槽接线；本次原厂运行未插卡。

3D来源与未确认内部结构见模型；重建模型的估计厚度不作为厂家尺寸。
TF数字卡接口已接入；本次原厂记录未插卡，不把无卡错误声明为卡槽不存在。
五秒原厂执行已写入显示像素，但最终快照单色；仍需逐项核验界面资源、时序与交互。

knowledge.title: Waveshare ESP32-C6-LCD-1.54
knowledge.summary: 1.54 英寸 240×240 ST7789，16 MiB Flash、无PSRAM；无触摸。

facts.label: 原厂镜像字节与分区验证

value.officialFactory: exact downloaded merged image; checksums pass; application partial
value.note: Exact path presence is source support, not a verified flashable image; lack of a matching named path is limited to the pinned inspected tree.

facts.label: 厂家资料冲突及采用依据
value: External W25Q128 and QFN40 C6 are16 MiB, notC6FH8/8 MiB.
Overview incorrectly calls0x30 and0x80 seven-bit codec addresses; those are eight-bit forms. Schematic straps and BSP requireES8311@0x18 andES7210@0x40.
Schematic title block saysESP32-S3-Touch-LCD1.54, but the actual MCU symbol and current exact product areESP32-C6.
Touch reset shares LCD GPIO4 through the real network; both lines use actual pulldowns, not fabricated pullups.
